runs.t: Smoother path to stakeholder consensus with a single point of contact, entitlements through handover
Dedicated parking specialists guide the process from entitlement to handover — with deep expertise in parking structure design, layout, and code compliance.
One 5-year warranty for the entire parking structure — no finger-pointing between trades, no gaps in coverage.
30%–50% faster than traditional methods. Manufacturing of the structure occurs simultaneously with site and foundation work.
Long-span double tees create open, flexible layouts with fewer interior columns — improving visibility, circulation, and adaptability for future uses.
Designed for increased safety and better navigation with intentionally brighter lighting above code minimum at entrances, pathways, and circulation areas.
Every PARC structure uses our proprietary low-carbon concrete mix as standard — reducing embodied carbon by ~20% vs. traditional mixes.
CARBONSHIELD® is a unique and proprietary concrete mix developed by Clark Pacific that provides the same performance as traditional mixes and is standard in our structural products.
It replaces 25% of the portland cement in our concrete mixes, reducing embodied carbon by roughly 20%. Our goal is double this by 2030, through our continuous R&D efforts and material partnerships.
Planning and design guidance for prefabricated parking structures — bay layouts, circulation, seismic systems, and finish options.
Prefabrication met all of our prerequisites
whereas cast-in-place would have taken longer, cost more, required a greater footprint on site and been very disruptive to Major League Soccer games.
What is the typical floor-to-floor height in a PARC structure?

PARC structures are typically designed with floor-to-floor heights of approximately 11'–6" on accessible parking levels and 10'–6" on typical parking levels. These clearances are optimized for efficient layouts while allowing space for lighting, signage, and MEP systems.
